title: For an augury of good or evil?
html_source:
Stephen can’t tell if the birds represent good or evil. Their flight plays on his last name of Dedalus as Daedalus was one that could fly away to distant places. Stephen is contemplating whether or not his flight from his family would be good or bad (evil).

Here is Daedalus flying as depicted by Greek Mythology.

 Why was he gazing upwards from the steps of the porch, hearing their shrill twofold cry, watching their flight?
